recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-key portrait of a male subject emerging from deep shadow, framed by bold, stylized typography at the top and bottom. The lighting is harsh and directional, emphasizing facial texture and sweat, while the background is a solid, impenetrable black.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up portrait as the central visual anchor
Top-aligned blue sans-serif text contrasting with bottom-aligned metallic text
Deep shadows creating a mask-like effect across the eyes
Geometric diamond-shaped graphic element on the right mid-ground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies 80% of the frame, centered vertically and horizontally, cropped tightly at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit nose and mouth area of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top blue text, drop to the central facial highlights, and finish at the heavy metallic base text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the head and filling the eye sockets.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric blue (Top text) and Silver/Chrome (Bottom text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between highlights and shadows; low saturation in the portrait with high saturation in the blue text.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Blocky, sans-serif with a hard drop shadow
Bottom text: Wide, industrial, metallic-effect with horizontal striations
Uniform stroke weight for the top text
Beveled edges for the bottom text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Q' in the bottom text features a vertical bar extending below the baseline
Letters in the bottom row are stretched horizontally to create a heavy base
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a vibrant, flat condensed sans-serif and a wide, textured metallic display face.
graphicDevices: Diamond-shaped line-art logo on the right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the top text
Provides the wide, industrial skeleton for the bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-key portrait of a man with dark skin, sweating, emerging from a black void. Light should hit only the forehead, nose, and lips, leaving the eyes in total shadow. Leave clear space at the top and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered uppercase text at the top in a condensed blue sans-serif with a hard black drop shadow. Add centered uppercase text at the bottom in a wide, chrome-textured industrial font with a beveled 3D effect.

verificationChecks: Are the eyes obscured by shadow?
Is there a clear color distinction between top and bottom text?
Is the bottom text horizontally extended?

adjustableVariables: Degree of horizontal stretch on bottom text
mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no facial features are visible in the eye sockets
Check that the metallic texture on the bottom text looks reflective
Verify the top text blue is vibrant and saturated
Confirm the composition remains strictly symmetrical
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key portrait + Condensed Blue Sans (Top) + Extended Chrome Display (Bottom) = Urban Power Aesthetic
